hero.subtitle: NTIGI does not charge flat monthly subscription fees. Your clients pay based on what they send or receive: package weight, dimensions, route, service level, and handling requirements. You configure the rates. NTIGI calculates and invoices automatically.

factorsSection.title: What Determines the Cost of a Shipment
factorsSection.subtitle: Each shipment is priced by combining the relevant factors below. You configure all of them. Your rates, your rules, your margins.

factors.title: Package Weight
factors.desc: Rates are calculated by actual weight. Define weight bands with different prices per kilogram or per fixed band. Heavier shipments move to higher tiers automatically.
factors.example: 0 to 5 kg: base rate / 5 to 20 kg: mid rate / 20 kg plus: bulk rate

factors.title: Dimensions and Volume
factors.desc: Volumetric weight is calculated from package dimensions. The system automatically applies the higher of actual weight or volumetric weight.
factors.example: Oversized light packages are billed by cubic volume, not just mass

factors.title: Route and Zone
factors.desc: Each route has its own rate card. Zone-based pricing groups origins and destinations into pricing zones. Cross-zone shipments apply the configured inter-zone rate.
factors.example: Zone A to Zone A: local rate / Zone A to Zone B: regional rate

factors.title: Package Type
factors.desc: Different rates apply to envelopes, parcels, boxes, and pallets. Each package type has configurable base rates, size restrictions, and weight limits.
factors.example: Envelope: flat rate / Standard box: weight-based / Pallet: volume-based

factors.title: Service Level
factors.desc: Standard, express, same-day, next-day, and overnight service levels each carry their own rate multiplier or fixed surcharge applied on top of the base route rate.
factors.example: Standard: base / Express: base + 30% / Same-day: base + 60%

factors.title: Fuel Surcharge
factors.desc: Apply a configurable fuel surcharge as a percentage or fixed amount per shipment. Update it globally or per route to reflect changing fuel costs.
factors.example: Current surcharge: configured per route or network-wide

factors.title: Handling Fees
factors.desc: Apply additional charges for special handling requirements: fragile, perishable, hazardous, oversized, or white glove service. Mapped to 22 cargo handling tags.

factors.title: Duties and Taxes
factors.desc: For international shipments, customs duties and VAT are calculated per HS code and destination country. Added to the invoice automatically at booking.
factors.example: HS code + destination = applicable duty rate applied to declared value
